faqs.question: How to get a Netherlands work permit from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: You typically need a genuine Netherlands job offer/authorization, then a complete national visa file. SK Immigration prepares the Pakistan-side documents from PKR 80,000; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Netherlands work visa?
faqs.answer: Passport, contract/authorization, CV, certificates, and any medical/police documents requested. Exact lists vary — we build a checklist for your case.

faqs.question: SK Immigration Netherlands work fee?
faqs.answer: From PKR 80,000 for preparation support. Official fees are separate. No guarantees.

faqs.question: Do I need local language for Netherlands?
faqs.answer: Often helpful; some international roles use English. We assess language before you invest.

faqs.question: Can I convert a visit visa to work in Netherlands?
faqs.answer: Not as a DIY loophole. Work needs the correct authorization. We advise legal routes only.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee the visa?
faqs.answer: No. Immigration authorities decide every application.

body:
Netherlands work permit / work visa from Pakistan

The Netherlands is popular for skilled and highly skilled migrant routes when employers meet salary thresholds. Tourist entry is not a work shortcut.

Requirements

  • Dutch employment contract / sponsorship as required
  • Passport and forms
  • Qualifications matching the role
  • Salary meeting route thresholds where applicable
  • Insurance and civil docs as requested

Process

  1. Contract eligibility check
  2. Document packaging
  3. MVV / visa prep as applicable
  4. Biometrics
  5. Arrival registration briefing

Documents

  • Passport, photos
  • Signed contract
  • CV and degrees
  • Translations if required
  • Fee receipts

Checklist tool: Open checklist →

Fees

SK from PKR 80,000. Authority fees separate.

Timeline

Often 2–5 months after a compliant offer.

Common mistakes

  • Salary below legal thresholds
  • Fake job offers
  • Missing translations
  • Visit visa for work intent

Related

All work permits · Visit visas · Jobs board · Ausbildung

Work route reality check for Netherlands

Highly skilled / employer routes have salary and IND criteria.

SK Immigration helps with CV packaging, document checklists and appointment prep. We do not sell fake job guarantees. Employers and missions decide.

Before you pay anyone

  • Confirm the job/contract type matches the visa subclass
  • Language level matches employer expectations
  • Educational documents follow the correct attestation chain
  • You understand SK fees vs medical/government fees
